description: This file defines the FormErrorHandler class in Drupal, responsible for handling, displaying, and organizing form validation errors.

classes.name: FormErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles form errors by displaying messages and organizing error information within form elements.

methods.name: handleFormErrors
methods.description: Main method to handle form errors: displays errors and sets element errors based on form state.

methods.name: displayErrorMessages
methods.description: Displays all form errors as messages.

methods.name: setElementErrorsFromFormState
methods.description: Recursively assigns errors to form elements and their groups based on form state.
